name: 5-MAPDB
summary: An entactogenic drug with similar effects to MDMA. The drug is structurally related to 5-MAPB. The drug is suspected to release serotonin and have neurotoxicity concerns similar to MDMA.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.text: 5-MAPDB has been studied to determine its pharmacological activity, and was found to be a relatively selective serotonin releaser, though with weaker actions as a releaser of other monoamines and 5-HT2 receptor family agonist, similar to older compounds such as 5-APDB.

uses.text: It is structurally related to drugs like 5-APDB and 5-MAPB, which have similar effects to MDMA and have been used as recreational drugs. 5-MAPDB has been studied to determine its pharmacological activity, and was found to be a relatively selective serotonin releaser, though with weaker actions as a releaser of other monoamines and 5-HT2 receptor family agonist, similar to older compounds such as 5-APDB.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs that release serotonin strongly, such as MDMA, can cause jaw clenching, sweating, overheating, nausea, a racing heart and a low mood in the days after. Serious risks include dangerous overheating, low blood sodium from drinking too much water, and serotonin syndrome.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。強烈釋放血清素的藥物（例如MDMA）可能引起咬緊牙關、出汗、體溫過高、噁心、心跳急促，以及之後幾天的情緒低落。嚴重風險包括危險的體溫過高、因喝太多水造成的低血鈉，以及血清素症候群。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。强烈释放血清素的药物（例如MDMA）可能引起咬紧牙关、出汗、体温过高、恶心、心跳急促，以及之后几天的情绪低落。严重风险包括危险的体温过高、因喝太多水造成的低血钠，以及血清素症候群。

fact.en: Its dihydrobenzofuran ring is the saturated version of the benzofuran ring in 5-MAPB, with two extra hydrogen atoms that remove one double bond.
fact.zh: 它的二氫苯并呋喃環是5-MAPB苯并呋喃環的飽和版本，多了兩個氫原子，少了一個雙鍵。
fact.zhHans: 它的二氢苯并呋喃环是5-MAPB苯并呋喃环的饱和版本，多了两个氢原子，少了一个双键。
